summary: New System Settings appearance/anti-bot toggles (no migrations, inline-safe): layout_config gains sticky-header + zebra-striping toggles, default form density, and default modal size; registration_config gains a honeypot enable toggle gating the existing website bot-trap; public_root_config gains a fixed public-root theme, public-root <title>/meta-description overrides, and centralized show_titlebar_on_public + show_sidebar_on_public toggles (default hidden) that supersede titlebar_config.hide_on_public_unauthenticated_index and replace the hardcoded hide-sidebar-for-anonymous behavior. Also hardens the updater: reconcile reverts an unreconstructable active release to the baked image and self-heals a stuck degraded flag once back on baked, and the scaffold supervisor derives DLUX_BAKED_VERSION from dlux.__version__ so bind-mount dev works.
